stationary_bootstrap_logical_order.outer_replication_numbering: zero-based 0..1999 per the frozen payload grammar
stationary_bootstrap_logical_order.position_zero_rule: position 0 emits the initial index directly and has no restart decision
stationary_bootstrap_logical_order.restart_decision_timing: logically at position t before the index at position t is defined
stationary_bootstrap_logical_order.restart_index_allocation: the RESTART_INDEX coordinate at position t is logically allocated whether or not r[t] is true; when false it is simply not evaluated and this cannot shift any other draw
stationary_bootstrap_logical_order.shared_synchronous_path: one index path per (dgp_or_case_id, outer, bootstrap) payload is shared identically by all nine series per the frozen bootstrap_draw_ordering
stationary_bootstrap_logical_order.wraparound_rule: continuation from index 2192 wraps to index 0 via modulo 2193
